requirements.title: Reproducible startup
requirements.acceptance: A clean checkout starts API, worker and UI with documented commands and seeded fictional tenants.
verified_behavior: A clean extraction/import of the final 0.2.0 wheel matches every current packaged Python source and excludes test modules; final interface, fictional login, notice-bound call lifecycle, token revocation and a synthetic operations tick are exercised.
The documented standalone worker entry point is exercised as a real process for cooperative shutdown and cancellation at the drain deadline.
acceptance_limits: Clean built-wheel extraction with existing locked dependencies and fresh isolated SQLite; no fresh operating-system or Docker runtime execution claim.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL deployment
requirements.acceptance: Deployment uses PostgreSQL with validated schema/migrations and independent-connection contention tests.
verified_behavior: Production PostgreSQL validates schema version 0002 and all 88 application tables plus schema_version. Ten isolated configuration/startup checks passed.

Actual PostgreSQL 16.15 independent-connection contention exercised 402 operations across five cases with up to 100 contenders, one committed logical booking/notice, no duplicate occupancy and wrong-tenant 404.
Four purpose-retention cases additionally ran against fresh isolated PostgreSQL schemas.
acceptance_limits: Synthetic local correctness checks; recorded timings under shared build load do not certify customer-database capacity or voice latency.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Dependency reproducibility
requirements.acceptance: Backend and frontend dependencies are pinned/locked; installation and build are repeatable.
verified_behavior: Python, frontend, Electron and Capacitor dependencies have checked-in pinned versions or lock files; version alignment is checked before release.
The native projects use Java 21/SDK 36 and a checksum-pinned Gradle wrapper; actual local Windows and Android builds consume the same final interface.
Twenty-one locked web runtime packages have generated bundled license notices, with retained upstream text and provenance for the missing npm license.
acceptance_limits: Local repeatable build controls do not claim hermetic reproduction on every OS, a current universal advisory audit, or model-weight reproducibility.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Schema migration and rollback
requirements.acceptance: Versioned migrations have tested upgrade and documented rollback/recovery procedures.
verified_behavior: Nine version 0002 migration cases cover fresh/repeat startup, valid 0001 upgrade, preserved records, legacy billing-note encryption, ambiguous/damaged schema refusal and transaction rollback on failure.
The runbook documents compatible-image rollback or isolated pre-change restore with reconciliation; the actual encrypted 89-table restore drill succeeded.
acceptance_limits: No destructive schema downgrade or production live-write recovery acceptance is claimed.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Automated CI
requirements.acceptance: CI runs necessary backend, frontend, type/build, contract and integration gates without live customer credentials.
verified_behavior: SHA-pinned GitHub workflows invoke Python lint/test, PostgreSQL contention/startup, frontend type/build and 12 isolated synthetic browser suites including the focused per-tool latency-label contract, desktop contracts, and nonroot Docker startup.

Native release jobs consume the verified web artifact, produce exact current-version Windows and Android packages, verify requested signatures and collect byte-bound checksums/metadata; only the guarded optional draft job has write permission.
Workflow lint and isolated collector fixtures passed locally. The Docker frontend COPY/prebuild context was exercised without a Docker engine.
remaining_acceptance: Connect the intended authorized repository and execute its actual workflows; retain the remote run and Docker startup results.
acceptance_limits: Local commands and static workflow validation do not establish a remote Actions run or Docker image execution.
external_dependencies: Connect the intended authorized repository and execute its actual workflows; retain the remote run and Docker startup results.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Source and secret hygiene
requirements.acceptance: Source package excludes real PII/audio, generated databases, tokens and dependency directories.
verified_behavior: The final source package excludes credentials, generated databases, dependency trees, native outputs, screenshots, downloaded models and private signing/backup material.
An exact source payload inventory records hashes, and the assembled ZIP is checked for CRC integrity and identical payload bytes; six explicitly synthetic non-speech tone WAV fixtures are retained.
acceptance_limits: Category/private-marker inspection is not a universal secret detector. Package checks cover the exact delivered selection.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Requirement traceability
requirements.acceptance: All source areas and unique later-phase directions map to status and evidence; unverified external gates remain explicit.
verified_behavior: All 263 original requirement IDs, phase assignments, source sections and acceptance statements remain unchanged. Current evidence maps and the scoped UI supplement are reconciled into one status per ID with limits and remaining acceptance.
The new native/release acceptance matrix is recorded separately so added features do not inflate the original requirement count.
acceptance_limits: Owners denote accountable roles to assign; real people, approvals and field results are not fabricated.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Restore drill tooling
requirements.acceptance: Documented recovery procedure restores a test backup and verifies appointment and outbox consistency.
verified_behavior: An actual local encrypted PostgreSQL backup/restore recovered all 89 version 0002 tables into an isolated empty database with matching counts, zero duplicate/orphan occupancy, appointment decryption and four new protected-data roundtrips.
acceptance_limits: Synthetic quiescent local recovery; no offsite custody/durability, continuous backup service, production RPO/RTO or live-write count equivalence claim.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Meaningful verification report
requirements.acceptance: Report names exact commands, environment, counts and uncovered external gates; no guessed pass claims.
verified_behavior: The 0.2 report records actual commands, environments, artifact hashes and current verification outcomes; broad historical and focused final amendment evidence are distinguished and overlapping tests are not summed.
Every remaining original requirement and the native signing/device/deployment boundaries are retained explicitly.
acceptance_limits: Synthetic/local verification does not certify clinical/privacy approval, production providers, real-device quality or commercial outcomes.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.

requirements.title: Handoff transport truth
requirements.acceptance: Requested/ringing/accepted/connected/failed states follow real transport events; a task is not a connected call.
verified_behavior: A queued staff task is distinct from a connected call. A verified, authorized LiveKit participant event establishes HUMAN_CONNECTED and stops automated conversation; later events cannot downgrade that connection.

The Asterisk AudioSocket adapter requests a handoff and returns to an approved cold-transfer dialplan. Its capability explicitly reports human_join_observable=false; it does not infer that the target answered.
remaining_acceptance: Select the approved PBX/carrier transport and implement its authenticated requested/ringing/accepted/failed event mapping, ordering/replay handling and warm-transfer/bridge integration.

Run adapter conformance and failure/recovery tests, then demonstrate actual ringing, acceptance, human audio connection, no-answer fallback and AI shutdown on the intended carrier and staff endpoints.
acceptance_limits: Queued and verified-connected behavior is implemented. The full requested/ringing/accepted/failed state adapter and PBX/carrier warm-transfer integration are not implemented; source inspection and synthetic fixtures cannot supply those transport events.
external_dependencies: Approved PBX/carrier event and transfer contract, authorized test trunk/DID, reachable staff endpoints and accountable operator.
requirements.scope: Version 0.2.0 platform, package, migration and delivery evidence; no live supplier or production release claim.
